title: Chapter 252: The Walled City
content:
Chapter 252: The Walled City

Seeing the stiff expressions on their faces, Wang Shuo was very satisfied.

This move was to make them realize that Wana Village was still very powerful and could compete with Nanshan Group, giving them some confidence.

This time, Wang Shuo did not bring out catapults and crossbows, although as an ally, he still had to keep some cards.

Finally, Wang Shuo took everyone to visit Wana Village's copy - the Ancient Battlefield.

It can be said that the copy of Wang Shuo's territory is the only copy in Changping County that is controlled by players, which also gave everyone a great shock.

They thought that this copy was only in Wana Village, but they didn't expect that Wang Shuo could adjust the data in this copy.

So far, several lords have made up their minds and want to follow Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo accompanied a group of lords to visit many places in Wana Village and discussed with each other about the experience of building a territory.

Until the evening, everyone left one by one.

Most of the lords said they would respond to Wang Shuo's call, and they would prepare for related matters when they returned.

Some of them only sent important personnel from the territory, and the lords themselves did not come.

They said that they would go back to discuss before making a decision.

Wang Shuo also expressed his understanding.

The next morning, after breakfast, Wang Shuo summoned Hadro again.

The more strategic materials, the better.

This time, Hadro prepared a large number of war weapons.

[Thunderbolt: Causes 1,000 points of damage to enemies within 5 square meters, and 500 points of damage to enemies within 10 square meters. ]

This is an upgraded version of Thunderbolt, which is extremely powerful and can be attached to arrows and fired.

Good stuff!

200 gold coins each, although a little expensive, but the effect is also beyond words. Wang Shuo directly bought all 10,000 pieces that Hadro brought.

In addition, there are a large number of talismans, defense talismans, and attack talismans. Wang Shuo did not think it was too much and bought 2,000 of each.

Hadro had prepared many weapons this time, but Wang Shuo did not buy them after seeing them. After all, the weapons and armors in Wana Village were better than the fine ones, and the gold equipment could reach the point of mass production.

Seeing this, Hadro also understood that Wang Shuo's territory had developed quite well, and ordinary things were already difficult to satisfy.

So, he took out a blueprint.

"Warhorse armor manufacturing blueprint"

Wang Shuo's eyes lit up, this was the good thing that Wang Shuo had always wanted!

Only cavalry equipped with warhorse armor can be truly called heavy cavalry.

This blueprint was not expensive, and it only cost 500 energy crystals to exchange it.

The two had a brief conversation for a while, discussed the types of materials that needed to be purchased in the future, and Hadro turned and left.

Not long after, the system prompt was heard again.

[The construction of the territory wall is completed. ]

Wang Shuo was delighted and hurried to the new wall.

This time the wall was taller and wider, with a total length of nearly 20 kilometers.

At the four city gates, a barbican was also built.

The specifications are higher than the city wall being built in Nanshanji.

The defense capability of Wana Village has been upgraded to a higher level.

Wang Shuo found Baili Liang and communicated with him about the arrangements and deployment of the city defense army.

The safety of Wana Village must be foolproof during this expedition. If someone steals the hometown, Wang Shuo will regret it.

The current city defense army is almost 1,000 people, and it is still a bit stressful to defend such a long city wall.

Wang Shuo specially asked the crossbow battalion to allocate 100 people to assist in defense.

At the same time, the craftsman battalion was also asked to build a large number of intermediate arrow towers near the city wall.

In this way, even if the Chiyan Army is not in the territory, Wana Village should be able to hold on for a long time.

This is the case when the enemy attacking the city has heavy weapons. If there is no siege equipment, I am afraid that they can't even climb the city wall. After all, the height of the new city wall has reached 12 meters.
